text: I think the best thing you can do for boys is just treat their mother really well. They just see it. I really try to demonstrate emotion and affection around her. I defer to her judgment in front of the boys. I just try to make sure the boys know that their mother is really valuable and they see it by the way I treat her. I think that's going to create much more healthy relationships for them. I think that's the best thing you can do for your boys. Even if you're divorced, just be really good to the mother.
And I think it really, quite frankly,
damaged my relationship probably with women.
I think I could have been kinder to women
when I was a young man.
